source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies two independently corrupted repeated measurements, establishes blind-signal identifiability, and gives compact-support minimax density-rate results.
The article identifies an ADRF for an error-contaminated continuous treatment, proposes an estimator, and derives asymptotic inference ingredients.
